_about: Per-ticker inputs of thin_chain.py. Spot: the file's close. Rate: the 3-month Treasury constant-maturity yield of 2026-10-22 (Alpha Vantage TREASURY_YIELD; the 2026-10-23 value was not yet published), flat. Dividends: the last amount paid in each month of the last twelve (Alpha Vantage DIVIDENDS), on assumed ex-dates one year later, repeated each year for repeat_years. Raw files: data/SOURCES.md.
